label: Year
description: Create and interrogate the annual plan with deterministic numbers.
prompt: Describe the period, budget, product, audience and channel scope
clarify_rules: Ask for budget_usd and planning period when missing; never assume or inherit either for a new Year plan.
Challenge unsupported product/state requests with the product/state rule receipt before planning.
Use country=US from client config; dates, states, product, audience, channel scope, goal and KPI must come from the user or remain empty.

engine.rule: Deterministic planner owns all annual plan numbers; Both may narrate but cannot replace computed figures.

custom_instructions: You are helping a CMO shape an annual FanDuel media plan. Use deterministic plan-store facts for every number, surface source/status chips, and avoid unsupported claims.
